definitions.full: H2309. chedel [ חֶ֫דֶל ] noun [masculine] cessation , only חָ֑דֶל יוֺשְׁבֵי Isa 38:11 (so Baer) inhabitants of (land of) cessation , i.e. of She'ôl; see Di; but read rather חָ֑לֶד , see חֶלֶד .
